metadataRaw.title: Self Pop Your Foot 💥
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise that may end in a satisfying self pop, crack, or release in your foot.

This exercise will focus on improving range of motion in the metatarsals, the long bones of the foot. It's also great to use for general foot pain and metatarsalgia. 

Let us know how it works for you!
